label: Every giving by a one-power HAS_INTELLECT_1 being is by a rational power (inference)
rule: Will from intellect, a rational power from will, identify it with the exercised power by one power
meaning: An intellectual y has will (will follows intellect), hence some rational power q; each giving of y exercises some power p of y; with one power, p = q, so the giving exercises a rational power. Constructive.
